verdict.rationale: Bento documents real bulk endpoints: POST /batch/subscribers bulk creates or updates 1 to 1000 subscribers per request, POST /batch/events tracks events in batch, and the CLI imports subscribers from CSV. However, the evidence covers only bulk create, update, and import. Other bulk operations across many items are not shown. missing for 10: documented bulk tag/field/delete/unsubscribe operations across existing items, bulk actions via MCP for AI agents, independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk operations at scale.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: POST`/batch/subscribers` Import Subscribers Bulk create or update subscribers without triggering automations.
Request supports 1 to 1000 subscribers per post.
POST`/batch/events` Create Events Track user activity, update profile fields, and trigger automations.
Search subscribers, import from CSV, manage tags and fields
It also carries safety guidance for API keys, bulk subscriber imports, live account operations
